body:
CustomRecipe - Create, Manage & Control Crafting In-Game

Take full control of your server’s crafting system with a clean, admin-friendly GUI.

CustomRecipe lets you create custom recipes directly in game, manage them with one command, and keep a full audit trail of all actions.
Built for Paper servers with a focus on reliability, permission safety, and easy recipe administration.

✨ Features

In-Game Recipe Creator

- Full 3x3 crafting grid editor
- Separate output slot for result item
- Save new recipes without editing files manually
- Slug/id generation from item display name
- Automatic duplicate handling with \-xN suffixes

GUI-Based Management

- Main menu with clear navigation
- Recipe list with pagination (45 recipes per page)
- Recipe detail view
- Enable/disable existing recipes
- Delete recipes with safety confirmation countdown (10s)

Strong Safety & Data Handling

- Recipes stored in recipes.yml
- Automatic migration support
- Automatic backup creation with .bak files
- Backup retention limit (50 backups)
- JSONL audit logging in audit.log
- Permission snapshot logging for traceability

Craft Blocking Logic

- Disabled recipes are blocked from crafting
- Dual protection strategy:
  -recipe registry handling
  -crafting event fallback protection

Clean Permission Model

- Separate permission for basic usage vs management actions
- Denied actions are logged to audit

📦 Commands

/customrecipe
Opens the main custom recipe GUI.

/cr
Alias for /customrecipe.

🔐 Permissions

customrecipe.use
Allows player to use the command and open the GUI.

customrecipe.manage
Allows management actions (such as creating, enabling/disabling, deleting recipes).

🧭 GUI Overview

Main Menu
Central hub for all recipe actions.

Creator
Place ingredients in the 3x3 grid, place result in output slot, then save.

Recipe List
Browse all saved recipes page by page.

Disabler
Toggle recipes on/off without deleting them.

Deleter
Safely remove recipes with confirmation timer to prevent mistakes.


⚙️ Configuration Highlights

- strict\-sanitize option for stricter slug sanitizing
- Automatic file migration and backup behavior
- Structured audit trail for moderation/admin review

✅ Why Use CustomRecipe?
- No manual crafting JSON editing
- Faster admin workflow with GUI
- Safer operations with backups and audit logs
- Production-friendly management for live servers

If you want powerful in-game recipe control with minimal friction, CustomRecipe is built for exactly that.
